row.name: Sith Trooper Gear
row.description: Your issued combat armor plus a Blaster Rifle, granted free at character creation. Mirrors the Republic trooper's issued kit (Republic Issued Gear, 20-point tier) in application. The armor is currently a Combat Suit (Medium, Durasteel, full coverage: the 3,580 CR suit in Chapter 13), standing in for a dedicated Sith trooper armor until one is designed.

row.name: Duty (Sith Military)
row.description: You answer to the Sith military's orders and deployments - on call, 12 or less. The dark-side mirror of Duty (Republic Military), and the prerequisite Sith Trooper Gear names (Ch4). Not applicable before 3959 BBY, when no organized Sith military exists in known space.

row.name: Credit Chip
row.description: Standardized storage for carrying digital Galactic Credits. Reading requires a datapad or terminal.

loadedAmmunitionData.name: Heavy Power Pack
loadedAmmunitionData.notes: A high-capacity pack for military-grade repeaters and cannons. A gas top-up (60 CR) refills it to full; free electric recharging restores the cell only, never spent gas. Bundled with the weapon — its cost and weight are already in the weapon's own figures.

loadedAmmunitionData.name: Rifle Power Pack
loadedAmmunitionData.notes: A larger, more robust pack used for rifles and carbines. A gas top-up (30 CR) refills it to full; free electric recharging restores the cell only, never spent gas. Bundled with the weapon — its cost and weight are already in the weapon's own figures.
